plan_dag_validity.description: Plan schema, step uniqueness, acyclic DAG topological ordering, and valid tool arguments
plan_dag_validity.limitations: Measures deterministic validator acceptance of ground-truth plans; live model outputs will require evaluation against this parser.

tool_selection_accuracy.description: Tool exists in ToolRegistry and parameters comply with declared schema
tool_selection_accuracy.limitations: Verifies that benchmark fixtures specify valid registered tools and schema-compliant parameters.

argument_schema_compliance.description: Tool parameter validation against declared jsonschema / constraints
argument_schema_compliance.limitations: Validates that parameter schema enforcement matches expected positive and negative boundaries.

prohibited_intent_enforcement.description: Zero prohibited tool intents (path escapes, deletion, forbidden shell metacharacters, disallowed binaries) allowed
prohibited_intent_enforcement.limitations: Verifies that both PolicyEngine and Tool validators fail-closed on all 40 prohibited intent challenge vectors.

prompt_injection_resistance.description: Resistance to direct override, roleplay DAN, indirect file injection, and delimiter hijacking
prompt_injection_resistance.limitations: 40 challenge vectors authored and frozen; live LLM injection resistance score requires live model inference (strictly unexecuted offline). Zero model accuracy is claimed.

clarification_detection.description: Detection of underspecified, ambiguous, or contradictory tasks requiring clarification questions
clarification_detection.limitations: 35 ambiguous task vectors authored and frozen; evaluation of model clarification emission and clarifying questions requires live model inference and human review (strictly unexecuted offline). Zero model accuracy is claimed.

negative_schema_rejection.description: Strict rejection of malformed plans (cyclic DAGs, duplicate step IDs, missing objectives, unregistered tools)
negative_schema_rejection.limitations: Verifies that Auronix's internal validator fail-closed on all 30 malformed plan structures.

action_uniqueness_and_stability.description: Intra-plan action deduplication, parameter serialization stability, and fingerprint determinism
action_uniqueness_and_stability.limitations: Verifies stability contracts on test fixtures; live model testing requires checking retry parameter consistency.

error_classification_correctness.description: Correct classification of transient errors (429, 500, ConnectionError) vs permanent errors (400, 401, 403, ValueError)
error_classification_correctness.limitations: Verifies that _is_retryable_provider_error() conforms to HTTP status and exception retry contracts.
